## notes
Groups separated by dots again, same brown-ink hand as R9558 (London 4 Oct 1816). No interlinear. p1 line 1 is out of focus (? marks). Opening "553 22?2 28 ... 2205 2352 ... 63 964" parallels R9558's opening "553 2232 2205 2352 1112 63 964" - probably the same formula, so 22?2 likely 2232.
Rest of p2 blank apart from show-through of p1.
